note: Generated by tools/gen-goldens.ts from src/sim/aero/Throws.ts and throwDisc. Release states are asserted tightly; flights use the horizon tolerance.

backhand.about: Flat power throw. Turns over slightly while fast, fades back to the left as it slows.

forehand.about: Mirror of the backhand: opposite spin, so it turns and fades the other way.

hammer.about: Overhead, upside down. Inverted lift pulls it over the top and it drops hard and left.

scoober.about: Upside-down backhand grip. Short, breaks the opposite way to a hammer.

push.about: Chest-height dump. Low speed, low spin, dies quickly.

blade.about: Thrown on edge. Almost no vertical lift, so it knifes sideways and falls out of the sky.
